scope: E14 pools excluded from fitting and early stopping. Seen/unseen refers only to added generated-label training scaffolds; source-pretrained exposure is shared. This evaluates property predictions, not changes to generator yield. Off pools are unique coordinates, not duplicated target requests; off hit diagnostics use their stored P50 request.

ranking.scope: E15 prespecified top-4/top-8 by predicted point distance, ties by original candidate ID. Only physically accepted rankable endpoints; no replacement of SCF failures or missing slots. Off pools reused across five requests, not 640 unique proposals. Counts over request cells are occurrences; unique endpoint count reported separately. DFT labels never rank or fit here. Does not change original whole-pool generation yields.
